coordinateSystem.rotationsAndScales: none: every node is translation-only, so world = sum of translations up the tree

slab.note: outer edges are irregular/chipped by up to ~0.2 m; front face flat to about ±0.015 m

svgMapping.formula: x = (svgX - 250.446) * 0.018 ;  y = 6.0 - (svgY - 250.4345) * 0.018 ;  z = 0 at mid-depth, +1.2 at the front face

hierarchy: MonolithRoot > { BeamOrigin, CrackRootAnchor, LogoRoot > { HyperiuxLogoCore > LogoCore_*, CoreSphereAnchor > CoreSphere_Preview, BeamTarget }, SlabExcessChunks > BreakGroup_0N_* > SlabChunk_### } ; every Cracks_* mesh is a child of the stone piece it lies on

CrackRootAnchor.note: start of the Spine crack: bottom centre of the front face (z = 1.2), directly above BeamOrigin; Cracks_Spine uv.x = 0 here

logoCore.notes: Path1..4 are the four filled SVG paths at full slab depth, flush with the front face. LogoCore_CubeFrame is the 7-unit (0.126 m) stroke of the cube-outline path (outer hexagon ring + inner Y strokes) at full slab depth (z = -1.2 .. +1.2), flush with the front face and trimmed where it meets Path3/Path4. Its three compartments are a 1.0 m recessed pocket in the assembled slab (the cube cutout, as before): open from the front face to z = 0.2, where the BreakGroup_05 chunks behind them form the pocket floor; once those chunks break away the compartments are open front to back (top compartment about 32 x 85 SVG units clear). The paths' engraved grooves (2.2 cm x 4 cm) are filled: the logo outline on the face is a closed seam (draw the engraving in the shader, e.g. the logo-mask seam). Every LogoCore piece is grown ~4 mm into its neighbours behind its outer faces (hidden overlap); front/back faces and the front silhouette are unchanged.

coreSphere.svgCentre: hexagon centre of the cube-outline path (rounded top corner reconstructed): (248.86, 256.88)
coreSphere.note: The core sits in the 1.0 m recessed cube pocket, 0.62 m behind the front face, on the cube outline's full-depth vertical inner stroke, so CoreSphere_Preview intersects the CubeFrame. Preview mesh only (the site hides it and draws the core as a point light at the anchor).

beam.origin: BeamOrigin (ground, 0.35 m in front of the face, directly below the core)
beam.target: BeamTarget (front face, centre of the cube mark)

chunkExtras: each SlabChunk node carries extras: break_group, break_order (1 = first to go), volume_m3, explode_dir_gltf (unit vector, outward + toward camera), centroid_gltf. Pivot = bounding-box centre of the chunk. SlabChunk_067..082 are new (BreakGroup_05): the pieces behind the cube pocket's floor and the ones split off where the full-depth stroke cut through the old chunks.

energyCracks.uv: uv.x = distance along the crack network, normalised 0..1; uv.y = 0..1 across the strip. Grow cracks with a shader/alphaTest that keeps fragments where uv.x < progress. Core..LogoCore share one run: distance from the core outward (max path 7.10 m). Spine has its own run: uv.x = 0 at CrackRootAnchor (bottom centre) -> 1 at BeamTarget (main line 6.32 m), continuous across its six host pieces; its four side twigs continue the value from their branch point (0.26-0.31, 0.52-0.58, 0.79-0.87, 0.80-0.89), the two upper ones ending on the start of the Core strands, so the Spine reaches the Core network just before it reaches the core.
energyCracks.materials: one material per stage (EnergyCrack_Spine, EnergyCrack_Core ... EnergyCrack_LogoCore), emissiveFactor orange. Set emissiveIntensity = 0 for the dormant slab and animate it per stage in revealOrder (Spine first, from the slab's foot); add Bloom.
energyCracks.attachment: cracks on excess rock are children of their chunk, so they fly away with it; Cracks_LogoCore_* and Cracks_Spine__LogoCore_CubeFrame stay with the logo; Cracks_LogoCore_* are trimmed 1 SVG unit inside each path outline.

spine.path: single meandering fracture, max 0.22 m sideways, from (x -0.029, y 0.05) on the front face up the slab's centre, over the cube's bottom tip and along the vertical inner stroke to BeamTarget
spine.width_m: 0.075 at the foot tapering to 0.045 at the cube, 0.028 at the tip (twigs 0.6 x main -> 0.012)

materials.sameSource: both baked from one world-space procedural basalt, so the pattern is continuous across the core/excess seams

states.A_initial: all chunks at rest, crack emissive 0, sphere dim
states.B_activated: sphere + beam on, crack stages Core→Middle lit
states.D_forged: all SlabExcessChunks hidden/removed; LogoCore + Cracks_LogoCore + sphere remain

rayCoverage.method: re-imported GLB (Draco-decoded). Grid: rays every 1 cm from outside each side through the whole slab, counted where they are >=3 mm inside the slab outline; pass-through = no stone hit; culled = no FRONT-facing stone hit (as with single-sided materials). Seam: rays aimed at every seam line on the outer surface (3482 edges, 754.65 m), every 1 cm, offsets 0 / +-0.1 / +-0.5 mm across the line, tilts 0 / +-30 / +-60 deg.

seams.note: 0 rays pass through. The 16 seam rays without a front-facing hit (SlabChunk_046 at Path2's right edge, SlabChunk_061 at Path3's top corner) start inside the stone and point outward (audit artifact where a groove-fill piece touches its chunk); a 2 mm straight-on scan around them hits stone everywhere. The rest are aimed exactly at an edge line (zero offset).

validation.seamOverlap: each piece's inner (seam) faces are pushed into its neighbour: LogoCore_* by 4 mm, SlabChunk_* by 2 mm (2+2 mm chunk-chunk, 4+2 mm core-chunk). Vertices on the slab's outer surface are pinned, so front/back/perimeter faces and silhouettes do not move; the overlap ramps in over the first ~5 cm behind the front and back faces. Pieces triangulated, merged by distance, degenerate faces removed, all manifold with outward normals.

coreFrontAreaVsSvg.svg_parts: 4 filled paths 22.8716 + cube stroke outside them 0.9021
coreFrontAreaVsSvg.method: 1 cm ray grid on the re-imported GLB; 'withGrooveWalls' also counts the 3-4 mm of grown core wall visible inside the 4 cm path grooves

volumeCheck.exactPartition: before the seam overlap: chunks 229.357 m3 vs excess (slab - grooves - core) 229.358 m3, gap 0.001 m3
volumeCheck.afterOverlap: chunks 228.779 m3, core 58.863 m3 on re-import (includes the hidden overlap; grooves filled, 1.0 m cube pocket open)

validation.reimport: 168 nodes, 155 meshes, 82 chunks, 67 crack meshes (Spine 6), all anchors present incl. CrackRootAnchor, every node translation-only
validation.grooves: the 4 cm path grooves were ~1 px wide on screen and their walls flickered as bright lines along the logo edges (same on the previous asset); they are filled into the adjacent chunks (17 by boolean union, 15 as a second solid inside the same chunk overlapping the groove floor by 0.5 mm). Front rays on a 1 cm grid: no recess deeper than 5 mm anywhere on the face except the cube pocket and the chipped outer rim.
validation.textures: atlas space outside the UV islands is filled with the map's mean (basecolor, roughness) and flat normal, so distant mip levels don't blend in roughness 0 (mirror-like glints on thin faces).
